cases.name: P1_pos_z7_linear
cases.intended: rows a*x mod 7, a = 0..6 in order (D_0 = 0): every multiplier difference a_i - a_j is a non-zero element of the field Z_7, hence a unit, so every difference row is a permutation of Z_7; the 6 squares L_t[c][g] = (t*c + g) mod 7 are 6 MOLS(7)

cases.name: P2_pos_z13_linear
cases.intended: rows a*x mod 13, a = (5,0,12,1,7,3,10), pairwise distinct mod the prime 13, so every difference row is a permutation; D_0 = 5x is not the zero row, so the D_0 subtraction of the bridge is exercised; squares L_t[c][g] = ((a_t - 5)c + g) mod 13: 6 MOLS(13)

cases.name: N1_i_z13_transposition
cases.intended: P2 with the entries at columns 2 and 9 of row 4 (a = 7) swapped. For linear rows r, j the swap removes the differences (a_r-a_j)c1, (a_r-a_j)c2 and adds a_r*c2-a_j*c1, a_r*c1-a_j*c2; the difference row stays a permutation iff these sets coincide, i.e. iff a_r(c2-c1) = 0 or a_j(c2-c1) = 0 mod 13, i.e. iff a_r = 0 or a_j = 0. With a_4 = 7 exactly the row pairs (4,j) with a_j != 0 fail: (0,4),(2,4),(3,4),(4,5),(4,6); (1,4) survives (row 1 is the zero row). Bridge: (0,4) -> all 13 columns of L_4 not Latin (its rows stay Latin); (2,4),(3,4),(4,5),(4,6) -> those square pairs not orthogonal; L_1 stays orthogonal to L_4

cases.name: N2a_ii_z13_dup_row0
cases.intended: P2 with row 6 replaced by a copy of row 0 (a = 5): row pair (0,6) has all 13 differences 0; every other pair keeps a non-zero multiplier difference (5 - a_s for a_s in 0,12,1,7,3). Bridge: L_6[c][g] = g, every column constant -> all 13 columns of L_6 not Latin (rows Latin); no orthogonality failure, since L_6 is still orthogonal to L_1..L_5 in the distinct-pairs sense

cases.name: N2b_ii_z7_dup_rows_2_5
cases.intended: P1 with row 5 replaced by a copy of row 2: row pair (2,5) has all 7 differences 0; every other pair keeps a non-zero multiplier difference. Bridge: L_2 = L_5 (identical Latin squares) -> square pair (2,5) not orthogonal; all six squares Latin

cases.name: N3_iii_z9_k4
cases.intended: Z_9, k = 4, rows 0, x, 2x, 4x. Multiplier differences: 1, 2, 4 against row 0, 1 for rows (1,2), 3 for rows (1,3), 2 for rows (2,3). The units of Z_9 are the residues prime to 3, so 2 is a unit (2*5 = 10 = 1 mod 9) and the only non-unit difference is 3: exactly row pair (1,3) fails (3x takes only the values 0, 3, 6). Bridge: L_1, L_2, L_3 have column multipliers 1, 2, 4 (units) -> all Latin; square pair (1,3) not orthogonal

cases.name: N4_iv_malformed_length
cases.intended: P1 whose last line (line 7) has 6 integers instead of 7: violates "each line has exactly n integers"; must be rejected as MALFORMED (exit 2) before any property is evaluated

cases.name: X1_pos_z39_k3_linear
cases.intended: rows 0, x, 2x mod 39: multiplier differences 1, 2, 1 are prime to 39 -> 2 MOLS(39); exercises the target order and the --n/--k guard on a pass

cases.name: X2_neg_z39_k7_linear
cases.intended: rows a*x mod 39, a = 0..6, at the target shape 7 x 39. The multiplier difference j - i is a unit mod 39 = 3*13 iff 3 does not divide it, so exactly the row pairs with j - i in {3, 6} fail: (0,3),(0,6),(1,4),(2,5),(3,6). Bridge: L_3, L_6 (column multipliers 3, 6) have all 39 columns not Latin; square pairs (1,4),(2,5),(3,6) not orthogonal

cases.name: X3_pos_z7_crlf_blank
cases.intended: the P1 matrix written with CRLF line ends, space/TAB runs, leading and trailing blanks and three blank lines; the grammar accepts all of these and yields the same matrix -> PASS

cases.name: X4_dims_mismatch
cases.intended: a valid 7-row DM over Z_7 must not pass when --n 39 --k 7 is required

reason_contains: dimension mismatch: input has n=7 but --n 39 was required

cases.name: X5_out_of_range
cases.intended: line 4, column 4 holds 7 = n, outside [0, n)

cases.name: X6_bad_byte
cases.intended: line 3 holds the token '-1'; '-' (0x2d) is not an allowed byte

cases.name: X7_leading_zero
cases.intended: line 2, column 1 holds '01', a non-canonical decimal

cases.name: X8_single_row
cases.intended: one row defines no square; k >= 2 is required

reason_contains: need at least 2 non-empty lines (rows), found 1

cases.name: X10_usage_no_args
cases.intended: missing positional argument: the argparse error still yields one JSON line and exit 2

reason_contains: command line: the following arguments are required: dm

cases.name: X11_emit_pos_z13
cases.intended: --emit writes the 6 squares of P2; the harness compares the file byte for byte with the closed form L_t[c][g] = ((a_t - a_0)c + g) mod 13 in the documented layout

cases.name: X12_emit_existing_refused
cases.intended: exclusive create: an existing --emit target is refused with exit 3 and left byte-identical
